boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission, no-purchase activities on or near the University of Tampa campus and downtown waterfront.

cards.title: Walk Plant Park
cards.subtitle: On the University of Tampa campus
cards.notes: Meet by the river, take a slow lap beneath the trees, and use the park during its listed dawn-to-dusk public hours.
cards.short_summary: A public riverside park directly beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UT identifies Plant Park as a public park, open from dawn to dusk; its event-use procedure requires only a damage deposit.
cards.access_notes: Public park; open dawn to dusk. This card is for casual park use, not reserving an event.

cards.title: See Plant Hall’s public spaces
cards.subtitle: Plant Hall, University of Tampa
cards.notes: Enter through Plant Hall’s public lobby, then pause on the verandahs and front steps to look across campus and the river.
cards.short_summary: Historic campus architecture with documented public access.
cards.evidence_claim: UT states that Plant Hall’s lobby, restrooms, verandahs, front steps, and main-door area remain public space.
cards.source_title: Event Services — Plant Hall public-access guidance
cards.access_notes: The listed areas are public; ballrooms are private and may be in use.

cards.title: Bring a blanket to Water Works Park
cards.subtitle: 1710 N Highland Ave., Tampa
cards.notes: Set up in the open green space, use a picnic table, or walk to the riverfront dock without buying admission.
cards.short_summary: A public riverfront park with lawn and shaded seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa says Water Works Park is open to the public and has no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: City lists hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; specialty transport and rentals are separate purchases.

cards.title: Stroll the Tampa Riverwalk
cards.subtitle: Waterfront route near UT and downtown
cards.notes: Start at the campus-side riverfront and walk the public path with friends; stop at overlooks without entering ticketed attractions.
cards.short_summary: A free public waterfront walk connecting downtown destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa states that the Tampa Riverwalk remains open and free to the public.
cards.source_title: Celebrate the Fourth on the Riverwalk
cards.access_notes: Use the outdoor public path; museums, water taxis, and other businesses along it may charge separately.

cards.title: Ride the TECO Line Streetcar
cards.subtitle: Downtown, Channel District, and Ybor City
cards.notes: Board at a covered station for a car-free loop through downtown, Channelside, and Ybor; bring friends and hop off to explore.
cards.short_summary: A free heritage-streetcar ride across central Tampa.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tampa Bay says TECO Line Streetcar service is free seven days a week and serves 11 covered, wheelchair-accessible stations.
cards.access_notes: Service connects Downtown Tampa, Channel District, and Ybor City; verify departure timing before leaving.

cards.title: Catch Rock the Park
cards.subtitle: Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park, first Thursdays
cards.notes: Bring a friend and listen from the park lawn at this monthly outdoor music series; buying food from vendors is optional.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, free outdoor concert series downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa describes Rock the Park as a free monthly music series, typically at Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park on the first Thursday.
cards.access_notes: City lists upcoming 2026 dates from September through December; confirm the event page before attending.

cards.entity_name: Free Beginner Pickleball Lessons at Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park
cards.title: Try a free beginner pickleball lesson
cards.subtitle: Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park, north of UT
cards.notes: Join the listed beginner lesson with a friend, then use the park’s permanent or portable courts for a casual game.
cards.short_summary: City-listed free beginner instruction at a nearby riverfront park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa’s pickleball page lists free beginner lessons and identifies Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park’s courts.
cards.access_notes: The City lists two permanent and four portable-net courts; check the city page for lesson timing and bring suitable gear.

cards.entity_name: Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park Fitness Classes
cards.title: Join waterfront fitness class
cards.subtitle: Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park, downtown Tampa
cards.notes: Bring water and join an outdoor class on the waterfront lawn; the tourism bureau lists Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday sessions.
cards.short_summary: Free public fitness classes on Curtis Hixon’s waterfront lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tampa Bay states that free outdoor fitness classes are offered at Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Sundays at 6 p.m.
cards.source_title: Free Things to Do in Tampa Bay
cards.access_notes: The source lists 6 p.m. classes; verify the organizer’s current schedule and weather plan before going.

cards.title: Follow the Tampa Soulwalk
cards.subtitle: Downtown Tampa public-art and history trail
cards.notes: Download the guide or pick up the printed map, then walk a section together and pause at the public art and historic sites.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided route through Tampa’s Black history and public art.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Tampa says Soulwalk offers a free digital guide and printed map for nearly 100 public artworks and historic sites.
cards.access_notes: Use the free guide or map for public outdoor sites; route distance and stops can be tailored to the group.

cards.entity_name: John F. Germany Public Library Programs
cards.title: Drop into a library program
cards.subtitle: John F. Germany Public Library, downtown Tampa
cards.notes: Check the library calendar, choose a public program, and meet inside downtown’s main library without needing to buy admission.
cards.short_summary: Free public learning and community programs in downtown Tampa.
cards.evidence_claim: Tampa-Hillsborough County Public Library policy states that library programs are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Programs vary by date and may have age, capacity, or registration requirements; check the library calendar first.
